Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the productive call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the customer-led load test scheduled: 

Key SLOs you called out:
- p95 generation latency target: < 250ms for single-turn generate API
- Throughput target: sustained 200 req/s for 10m windows
- Concurrency: support 50 concurrent clients without queueing
- Streaming: yes, end-to-end streaming for chat flows required (we'll validate chunked delivery and early partial responses)

Redwood next steps / asks from FinWise:
1) Confirm preferred test window(s) (your team mentioned 6/29-7/2 as options)
2) Provide IP CIDR(s) to add to our allowlist (or we can provide static egress IPs)
3) Confirm whether you want us to run the k6 script we discussed or if you'll run Locust on your side
4) Provide test account(s) or we can provision scoped test keys (recommended for throttling visibility)

Attachments: draft k6 script (k6_script_v2.js) that mirrors the call profile we discussed.

I'll loop in Marissa to coordinate the test account and monitoring. If this looks right I can send a final mutual-action plan + test checklist.

Best,
Logan Wright

Monitoring & observability:

- We'll also stream tracing events into your Datadog account if you provide an intake token (optional).

- Logan: finalize MLP + runbook and share final k6/Locust parity notes (by 6/24)
- Marissa: create test API keys + confirm allowlist application window (by 6/24)
- Alex / Sandeep: confirm final test window (by 6/24) and confirm Datadog token if you want traces.

I'll follow up with the mutual action plan doc and the test checklist.
